gaps.sentence: The ___ (DECIDE) to close the factory was announced yesterday.
The ___ (ARRIVE) of the delegation was delayed by the storm.
With careful ___ (PREPARE), the trek is perfectly safe.
His sudden ___ (RESIGN) surprised everyone in the department.
gaps.hint: noun: act of leaving a job

gaps.sentence: The committee reached its verdict after lengthy ___ (DELIBERATE).
gaps.explanation: 'After lengthy deliberation' — the noun for careful discussion.

gaps.sentence: She was ___ (ABLE) to attend because of illness.
gaps.explanation: 'Unable to attend' — negative of able is unable.

gaps.sentence: The model predicts the weather with remarkable ___ (ACCURATE).
